sloka: गदापरिघहस्तौ तौ युधि वीरौ समीयतुः।नर्दन्तौ गौवृषप्रख्यौ घनाविव सविद्युतौ ।। ६.९८.२० ।।
transliteration: gadāparighahastau tau yudhi vīrau samīyatuḥ।nardantau gauvṛṣaprakhyau ghanāviva savidyutau ।। 6.98.20 ।।

translations.english: Then the hero, Mahodara, his horses destroyed, jumped from the great chariot, and took hold of a mace.
